lines.en: Worried that I will turn to dust if I do not leave the house soon, I make plans to meet up with Maki at the cafe and remind my body that, despite everything, it is still alive.
lines.zh: 我怕再不出门就要风化成一堆灰，于是约了 Maki 在咖啡厅见面，顺便提醒一下我的身体：不管怎么样，你还活着。

lines.en: Thankfully, she's in a much better mood than I am. So she takes the lead when it comes to conversation and even winds up buying my coffee for me.
lines.zh: 幸好她心情比我好得多。所以聊天基本是她带着走，最后连咖啡都是她请的。

lines.en: I try to tell her I don't mind paying, but she insists that this one is on her so she can express her gratitude for me or whatever.
lines.zh: 我试着说我不介意付钱，但她坚持这杯她请，说算是表达对我的感谢之类的。

lines.en: I'm sure that's just pity, though. I'd probably do the same for her if she disappeared for two months.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定那只是同情。要是她消失两个月，我大概也会为她做同样的事。

lines.en: But, at the same time, I don't think I offered to pay for her after her husband died. So that tells you basically everything you need to know about my character.
lines.zh: 但话又说回来，她丈夫去世那会儿，我好像也没说要请她。所以你基本可以看出我这个人是什么德行了。

lines.en: The morning passes by without any issues and, eventually, Maki has to leave to start getting ready for work.
lines.zh: 一上午风平浪静地过去了，最后 Maki 得回去准备工作了。

lines.en: I question what exactly she needs to get ready for as a porn salesman and, as you may have guessed, that spiraled into a long-winded tangent about the importance of her job in society.
lines.zh: 我好奇一个卖色情制品的到底有什么好准备的——而你可能也猜到了，这个问题最后演变成一场关于她的工作对社会有多重要的长篇大论。

lines.en: And I agree. If it wasn't for porn, I doubt a lot of us would even exist.
lines.zh: 这我同意。要是没有色情制品，我怀疑我们很多人根本不会存在。

lines.en: So, for a brief moment, I curse the fact that porn exists before remembering that I need to consume it at least once per day in order to keep breathing.
lines.zh: 于是有那么一瞬间，我诅咒起色情制品的存在，随即想起自己每天至少得消费一次才能继续喘气。

lines.en: It's a terrible curse, but one that I have grown to accept.
lines.zh: 这是个可怕的诅咒，不过我已经学会接受了。

lines.en: I just wish I could see it the way she does.
lines.zh: 我只希望自己能像她那样看待这件事。
Maki 的好感度提升到了 [maki_love]!
